title: ResponseEnvelope
description: Standard wrapper for all command stdout output in JSON mode. Shape is invariant: the same five keys are always present regardless of success, failure, or result count. The envelope is self-describing: meta.exit_code carries the process exit code, so a consumer that only sees stdout can still classify the outcome.

ok.description: True if and only if meta.exit_code is SUCCESS (0). Derived field; commands never set it independently.

data.description: Primary command output on success, shaped by the command's output schema (REQ-C-015). On failure, null unless the command's output schema declares a failure payload: partial results (REQ-C-009), the conflicting resource (REQ-C-028), or a failed check report (REQ-O-026). Agents read error before acting on a failure payload. Never absent.

error.description: Null on success. Structured error object on any non-zero exit.

warnings.description: Non-fatal diagnostics as structured objects. May be empty. Never null.

code.description: Stable, machine-readable domain error identifier such as NOT_FOUND or TOKEN_EXPIRED. May equal an ExitCode name but is not required to; the exit code itself lives in meta.exit_code. Must not change between versions. Agents branch on this value.

message.description: Human-readable summary. May be localized. Agents do not parse this; they use code.

detail.description: Extended explanation or raw upstream error text. Optional.

cause.description: Underlying system error that triggered this failure, such as 'Connection refused (ECONNREFUSED)'. Optional.

context.description: Structured key-value facts about the failure (host, port, missing scopes, affected ids). Agents read these instead of parsing message.

docs_url.description: URL of documentation for this error code. Optional.

retryable.description: True if re-running the identical invocation unchanged may succeed; implies no side effects occurred. Mirrors ExitCodeEntry.retryable for the emitted code. False for caller-correctable failures; see fix_required.

retry_after_ms.description: Milliseconds the agent should wait before retrying. Present only when retryable is true and a specific back-off is known.

retry_strategy.description: Back-off strategy the agent should apply on retry. Present only when retryable is true.

fix_required.description: Condition the caller must correct before reissuing. Present only when retryable is false and the failure is caller-correctable; absent on terminal failures.

fix_command.description: Exact command invocation that resolves the fix_required condition, executable verbatim with no placeholders. Must be read-only or idempotent, never destructive. Present only when retryable is false and a single-command remediation exists.

phase.description: Pipeline phase in which the error occurred. 'validation' guarantees zero side effects.

suggestion.description: Actionable next step phrased for an agent. Optional.

redirect.description: Present only when exit code is REDIRECTED (13). Contains the replacement command.

code.description: Stable machine-readable warning identifier such as DEPRECATED_FLAG or FIELD_TRUNCATED. Agents branch on this value.

message.description: Human-readable summary. Agents do not parse this; they use code and context.

context.description: Structured facts about the warning (field path, byte counts, versions, intercepted text).

command.description: Exact replacement invocation the agent MUST use verbatim on retry.

permanent.description: True if the mapping is permanent: the agent memorizes it and never calls the old form again. False if temporary: the replacement applies to this request only.

reason.description: Why the redirect exists. Informs whether the agent should update its schema knowledge.

total.description: Total number of items across all pages, or null when the backend cannot count them.

returned.description: Number of items in this response's data array.

truncated.description: True when a limit (default or --limit) cut the result set short.

has_more.description: True when at least one further page exists.

next_cursor.description: Opaque token to pass as --cursor for the next page. Null when has_more is false.

exit_code.description: Process exit code of this invocation. Identical to the code the process returns. Lets stdout-only consumers classify the outcome when the real exit code is lost to a pipeline, wrapper, or log.

duration_ms.description: Wall-clock time in milliseconds from command entry to final byte of output.

request_id.description: Opaque identifier for correlating logs, traces, and audit entries.

schema_version.description: MAJOR.MINOR version of this command's output contract (REQ-F-022). Major increments on breaking changes; minor on additive ones.

not_modified.description: True when an etag matched and data is intentionally null (cache hit).

truncated.description: True when the framework's byte size cap cut the output (REQ-F-052). Agents narrow the query or paginate.

pagination.description: Present on every list command response (REQ-F-018), including complete result sets.

_cmd.description: Dispatched command path echoed from the DispatchRequest. Present only on tool exec output lines (REQ-O-050).

_line.description: 1-based index of the input line this response answers. Present only on tool exec output lines (REQ-O-050).
